OUR STORE
ABOUT SHREE MART

A trusted local store for everyday shopping.

Shree Mart is a local grocery and FMCG store serving everyday shopping needs in Mango, Jamshedpur. From kitchen staples and snacks to beverages, dairy, frozen foods, household and personal-care essentials, the store brings everyday needs together under one roof.

Customers can visit the store, call or WhatsApp for current prices and availability. Party orders and larger quantity requirements can also be discussed directly with the Shree Mart team.
